evidence_status: All interior placements and sizes are explicit design assumptions, not surveyed or as-built information.
exclusions: No verified interior plans were supplied; no actual lift count, core outline, tenant layout or plant schedule is asserted.
No structural sizing, loads, reinforcement, connections or lateral analysis.
No fire strategy, egress-capacity assessment, accessibility certification or code-compliance assessment.
Pipes are connected conceptual routes, without hydraulic sizing, pressure zones, valves, insulation, hangers or rated penetrations.
Drain risers are shown; underground drainage and waste branches are not designed.
Mechanical plant is schematic; ducts, wiring, controls and ceilings are not fully designed.
The last level is reached by stairs in this concept; step-free access is unresolved.
The original approximate exterior and slab elevations are retained.
